Direct answer: The applicable rule and outcome are stated in the quoted operative text below.

Applicable summary text:
Must spend treasury until **£2 or less remains**. Lease extra ship £2; fit ship from shipyard £3 without owner consent; buy Company ship £5 **only if no ships remain on shipyards**. **Pay these acquisition fees from Shipping’s treasury to the bank; the shipyard owner does not receive the fitting fee.** Place each acquired ship in any sea zone, including China once office exists. Extra ships serve only until Refresh.

- **Form a firm — only if you currently manage none:** return one eligible Company share to supply or flip workshop to invested side. **Flip your family board to its firm-charter side**, then place a family member as first firm share, set value cube to leftmost track space and take £5 from bank into the London treasury.
- **Invest:** With manager's consent, same Company-share/workshop contribution creates one firm share and £5 bank to London. Up to ten firm shares; further investments still contribute £5 but create no shares. Cannot use Chairman share. Cannot use Company shares at all when Standing and/or Debt on lined space. Cannot use shares created this turn, even after trading them away. Invested workshops never return to uninvested: no bonus or Company-failure VP; they remain invested even if firm fails.
- **Ships:** A firm may fit a ship from **its own OR ANOTHER PLAYER'S shipyard**, but **must have that shipyard owner's consent**. Pay **£3 FROM the firm's London treasury TO the BANK**. May buy player-owned ship already in Company with owner's consent: unfatigued £3, fatigued £2, paid into Shipping treasury. Firms cannot acquire Company or extra ships.
- **Hostile takeover:** Only a player who **manages NO firm at all** may initiate one; managing a different firm also makes you ineligible. Obtain consent of holders of a majority of the target's shares, then move firm's ships, money and shares to own charter, copy both cube positions; former manager returns cubes and flips board to family side.
- **Merger:** Managers negotiate with **every shareholder's consent**. Highest-value firm is primary; if tied, players choose among tied. Transfer all secondary shares, ships and treasury funds to primary; secondary boards return to family sides. Players may negotiate share transfers. **If the primary would exceed ten shares, RETURN the excess shares to their OWNERS' SUPPLIES, with those owners' consent.** Entire agreement is one binding immediate transfer. Primary's value/dividend track remains the continuing firm's track.

Apply the same dissolution procedure as an insolvent firm: **shares go to Debtor's Prison (each −1 VP), ships return to their matching shipyards, and the charter flips to its family side. Workshops remain invested for the rest of the game.**

| Tax | **Each family pays £1 TO THE BANK per target it owns.** Each unpaid target returns to supply, including Chairman if taxed. Fitted ships of lost shipyards stay in play; shipyard unavailable for purchase until ship returns. Losing prize/luxury removes its VP. |

Direct answer: The applicable rule and outcome are stated in the quoted operative text below.

Applicable summary text:
After expenses, manager may pay dividends **from India treasury only**. Each dividend pays £1 per firm share plus £1 manager. **Waiving a dividend requires BOTH the shareholder's choice and the MANAGER'S CONSENT**; shareholder consent alone is insufficient. With that consent, the shareholder may forgo payment for any number of shares on any dividend. Record **total actual cash paid out**, not per-share dividend, with dividend cube on Company Balance track. An active non-Hobnob firm paying none records zero; Hobnob retains prior marker. Sweep remaining India money into London. Firm ships face storms in strategy zone; Hobnob exempts them.

- **Form a firm — only if you currently manage none:** return one eligible Company share to supply or flip workshop to invested side. **Flip your family board to its firm-charter side**, then place a family member as first firm share, set value cube to leftmost track space and take £5 from bank into the London treasury.
- **Invest:** With manager's consent, same Company-share/workshop contribution creates one firm share and £5 bank to London. Up to ten firm shares; further investments still contribute £5 but create no shares. Cannot use Chairman share. Cannot use Company shares at all when Standing and/or Debt on lined space. Cannot use shares created this turn, even after trading them away. Invested workshops never return to uninvested: no bonus or Company-failure VP; they remain invested even if firm fails.
- **Ships:** A firm may fit a ship from **its own OR ANOTHER PLAYER'S shipyard**, but **must have that shipyard owner's consent**. Pay **£3 FROM the firm's London treasury TO the BANK**. May buy player-owned ship already in Company with owner's consent: unfatigued £3, fatigued £2, paid into Shipping treasury. Firms cannot acquire Company or extra ships.
- **Hostile takeover:** Only a player who **manages NO firm at all** may initiate one; managing a different firm also makes you ineligible. Obtain consent of holders of a majority of the target's shares, then move firm's ships, money and shares to own charter, copy both cube positions; former manager returns cubes and flips board to family side.
- **Merger:** Managers negotiate with **every shareholder's consent**. Highest-value firm is primary; if tied, players choose among tied. Transfer all secondary shares, ships and treasury funds to primary; secondary boards return to family sides. Players may negotiate share transfers. **If the primary would exceed ten shares, RETURN the excess shares to their OWNERS' SUPPLIES, with those owners' consent.** Entire agreement is one binding immediate transfer. Primary's value/dividend track remains the continuing firm's track.
- **Voluntary dissolution:** All shareholders must consent. Apply the same dissolution procedure as an insolvent firm: **shares go to Debtor's Prison (each −1 VP), ships return to their matching shipyards, and the charter flips to its family side. Workshops remain invested for the rest of the game.**

1. **Expenses:** Reduce Balance £1 per existing Debt, each officer/regiment in an Army, and each ship in sea zones, including China. Exclude Commanders. If insufficient, take £5 emergency loans. Each loan advances Debt one **only while a track space remains**. **At maximum Debt, keep taking loans without advancing Debt any further.** Newly added emergency Debt causes no extra current-turn expense. After using emergency loans, set Balance to zero. One or two loans lower Standing one; three or more lower Standing two.
2. **Expectations:** Compare remaining Balance to the expectations under **current** Standing; if lower, lower Standing one.
3. **Dividends:** Chairman may pay any affordable number. Each dividend costs one cash per Company share; pay each owner £1 per share, including Chairman. If total cash paid as dividends is **strictly greater** than expectations, advance Standing one space.

If placing a family piece with none in supply, take one from any of your prizes and lose that prize's printed VP. This applies to firm-share creation too. If no family action is possible, take none and return opportunity marker to supply.
